From the author's The American atlas.

Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Soundings shown in fathoms. "The soundings along the Florida coast, shoals, islands, and reefs are in feet." Pictorial map. "DG.4." Two copies. Copy 1, boundaries outlined mostly in yellow. Copy 2, boundaries outlined mostly in red. From the author's The American atlas. On verso: [Plate no.] 24. Scale ca. 1:1,390,000; marine leagues 20 in a degree. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 1608 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
